meaning.VERIFIED_PLAYABLE: ffprobe detected video or ffmpeg decoded video frames
meaning.PARTIAL_VERIFIED: at least one source is VERIFIED_PLAYABLE
meaning.RESPONDS: server returned stream bytes but video decode was not confirmed
meaning.UNKNOWN: GitHub runner could not verify; do not treat as dead
meaning.DEAD_CONFIRMED: two final HTTP checks both returned explicit 404/410

ranking.rule: Prefer VERIFIED_PLAYABLE, then RESPONDS, then UNKNOWN; within the same state prefer FAST, then NORMAL, then SLOW, then lowest startup time
